messages:

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — MedGlobal is ready to move forward with Redwood for inference serving. Procurement has two items we need to resolve to complete vendor setup in Ariba and accept PO issuance: a handful of open redlines in the MSA and a short mapping file for PO fields (our ERP needs specific tags).

Could you confirm the following?
- Who at Redwood will own the MSA redline discussion (we'll share our comments as a tracked doc).
- Can you provide the preferred order-form template and the PO field mapping (CSV/XLSX) required for Ariba?
- Any required security questionnaire or SOC evidence we should attach to the portal?

We'd like to complete onboarding by Aug 7 if possible. Attaching our vendor intake checklist (pdf).

Best,
Tom Reyes
Director, Procurement
MedGlobal Inc.

Tom — thanks, excited to get MedGlobal onboarded. I'll coordinate both the legal redline and the PO field mapping. Short plan below: 

1) Legal: Marissa (cc'd) will review your tracked redline and send a decision log listing which exceptions we can accept, counter language, and any required commercial tradeoffs. Please have your counsel send the tracked MSA to marissa@redwood.com and Anna, I'll leave it with her for the legal thread.

2) PO mapping / Portal: Laura (ops) will attach our recommended Order Form template and an example mapping file for Ariba/Coupa. If you have a sample PO XML from your ERP, please share — that speeds mapping.

3) Security evidence: Kimberly will confirm what we can publish to the portal (SOC2 summary, encryption/KMS note, audit contact) and produce a short checklist for your security upload.

I'll consolidate into a single decision log once we have Marissa's legal responses. Targeting an internal SOW: accept/decline list by EOD 7/30 so we can get portal provisioning early next week.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, Procurement Team <procurement@medglobal.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 12:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding + MSA redline questions for Redwood

Tom / Vanessa — I reviewed MedGlobal's tracked changes (received from Anna Lewis). Summary of the material items and our proposed decisions below. I've attached a redline doc (Redline_MSA_MedGlobal_v3.docx) and a one-page decision log.

Key asks from MedGlobal and Redwood position (high level):
- Liability cap: MedGlobal requests a $20M cap. Redwood proposes a cap of $5M for standard customers; we can consider $10M limited to subscription fees for a 12-month term if MedGlobal signs a 24-month committed Dedicated plan. (Decision: counter to $10M conditional; commercial approval required).

- Data retention and access: MedGlobal requires 90-day deletion of customer data on termination. Redwood currently supports 30-day deletion by default but can offer a contractual 90-day deletion SLA with an addendum to the Order Form. (Decision: accept with addendum).

- Indemnity / IP carveouts: MedGlobal asked for broader carveouts for third-party data. Redwood will accept a narrower carveout limited to IP delivered by MedGlobal customers and will add mutual indemnity language tied to willful misconduct. (Decision: partial accept, propose wording in attached doc).

- Security audits: MedGlobal asked for on-site audits. Redwood will offer SOC2 report, penetration test summary, and an option for a remote evidence review. On-site audits will be scoped and charged separately. (Decision: offer remote review; on-site negotiable).

- PO netting / payment terms: MedGlobal wants Net 90 and PO netting. Redwood standard is Net 30. For enterprise onboarding we can accept Net 60 with a purchase order SOW that includes a payment milestone schedule. (Decision: counter to Net 60).

Next steps for legal:
- Anna and MedGlobal legal to confirm whether they can accept the conditional liability cap and the 90-day deletion addendum.
- Once agreed, I'll produce a clean MSA + order form for signature.

If anyone on the ops side sees a technical blocker in the PO field mapping that would prevent full automation into Ariba, flag it here.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
(attachment: Redline_MSA_MedGlobal_v3.docx)

---

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, Procurement Team <procurement@medglobal.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 14:09:00 -0700
Subject: PO field mapping / Ariba notes

Team / Tom — a few operational questions so portal provisioning won't stall: 

1) PO line item mapping: Our order system requires the following fields on PO: PO_Number, LineItem_ID, SKU, Quantity, UnitPrice, Currency, ShipToCode, GLCode (optional). Do you have these exact tags in Ariba? If not, we can provide a transform.

2) Acknowledgement window: Redwood's fulfillment requires PO acknowledgement within 48 hours for cloud activations; if your AR processes expect longer lead times, we need a contact and SLA.

3) Tax and billing party: Many customers use a different billing entity than the ship-to. Please confirm if the billing party for MedGlobal invoices will be "MedGlobal Inc." or a separate business unit.

4) Integration format: We can accept CSV export or an Ariba cXML payload. If you can share a sample cXML (or a screenshot of the field mapping), I'll pre-populate the OrderForm_PO_Field_Mapping.xlsx and return.

I'll attach the example mapping and a short checklist for our portal team.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Onboarding Lead, Customer Ops
Redwood Inference
(attachment: OrderForm_PO_Field_Mapping.xlsx)

I'll prepare a concise DocuSign packet after Marissa issues the clean docs. HubSpot deal: MG-2025-1017 (link above).
